label: Zoom
description: Schedule and look up Zoom meetings and register attendees.
notes: createMeeting: hardcoded type=2 (scheduled) since 'type' is a JSON number templates cannot emit; startTime is required in ISO 8601 UTC ('Z' suffix) so no timezone field is needed; numeric/boolean fields (duration, settings.* toggles, auto_recording/audio enums) dropped — Zoom applies account defaults; agenda kept optional because Zoom accepts an empty agenda string. addMeetingRegistrant: kept first_name/last_name/email only; other optional profile fields (country, phone, no_of_employees, custom_questions object mapping) dropped because empty-string values risk rejection or need object transformation. getMeeting: dropped optional occurrence_id / show_previous_occurrences query params rather than emit empty query values. zoom_update_meeting classified needsPieceRuntime: its PATCH body is built conditionally per provided field and includes booleans — empty-string values would clear or corrupt meeting settings. The piece's generic custom-API-call action was skipped as framework boilerplate.
